mechanics.claim: Amumu dashes to the target upon hit, and Despair can be cast during the dash.
Amumu is ordered to basic attack the target upon completion of the dash, which can trigger on-hit effects.
mechanics.quote: '''Amumu''' will be ordered to basic attack the target upon completion of the dash.

mechanics.claim: Bandage Toss periodically stocks a charge, up to a maximum of 2, allowing rapid recasts independent of the listed cooldown.
mechanics.quote: '''Amumu''' periodically [[stock]]s a ''Bandage Toss'' charge, up to a maximum of 2.

mechanics.claim: The ability still deals damage and stuns even if Amumu dies before the bandage lands.
mechanics.quote: ''Bandage Toss'' does not fizzle on '''Amumu's''' {{tip|death}}, and can still stun and damage enemies.

mechanics.claim: Amumu still dashes even if the spell is blocked by a spell shield.
mechanics.quote: '''Amumu''' is still able to {{tip|dash}} even if ''Bandage Toss'' is blocked by {{tip|spell shield}}.
